Klasse GameModel

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.GameModel
public class GameModel extends Object
An instance of a GameModel represents the game state of a single step.

A GameModel is a passive data container which stores the name of the agent, the step, the ring of nodes as a list, the maximum number of Fernies per node and the new Fernies of the current step.

It contains no logic for strategic decisions.

  • Konstruktordetails

    • GameModel

      public GameModel(String name, int step, List<Node> ring, int newFernies, int maxFernies, int absVis)
      Constructs a new instance of a GameModel for one step with the specified agent name, step number, ring, new Fernies, maximum number of Fernies per node, and absolute visibility of the current step.
      Parameter:
      name - the agent name
      step - the step number
      ring - a list of nodes forming the ring
      newFernies - the new Fernies of the current step
      maxFernies - the maximum number of Fernies per node
      absVis - the absolute visibility of the game

    • GameModel
